function: Adaptive CSI feedback compression: codeword length per image chosen by a learned PSNR evaluator, with DL CSI encoder/decoder (CLNet, 2D-DFT) and DeepSC-MIMO semantic JSCC (p. 1, 6-9).
system: 16x16 narrowband mmWave clustered MIMO channel (Nt=Nr=16, d=2 streams), SVD precoding with fed-back CSI, AWGN, CBR 1/12 and 1/24; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 10).
method: DeepSC-MIMO CNN autoencoder with CSI-aware attention (MSE loss); CLNet CSI codec; PSNR evaluator trained by regression and knowledge distillation from DeepSC-MIMO; offline training (p. 5-9).
data_channel: Simulated narrowband mmWave clustered channel [44] with AWGN; CIFAR10 (50,000 train, 10,000 test) and STL10 images; no 3GPP or measured channels (p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained at SNR -18 to 8 dB, tested at -16 to 6 dB (CIFAR10); Fig. 8 trained at codeword length 128, plotted over lengths 8-256 (p. 10-11).
baselines: Learned: DJSCC [4] (fixed-SNR training), ADJSCC (attention DJSCC), fixed-length CSI compression with CLNet [28]; CLNet with/without 2D-DFT; no non-learned method compared (p. 10, 14).
metrics: PSNR versus SNR and CBR; SDOP (semantic distortion outage probability); average required CSI codeword length; NMSE of CSI feedback; PSNR prediction MSE; model parameters (p. 6, 10-14).
complexity: Table II: DeepSC-MIMO 0.492M parameters; performance evaluator 0.323M, 0.149M, 0.068M for basic, small, tiny; no FLOPs or runtime (p. 13).
openness: none: no code or data link; only public CIFAR10 and STL10 images and a channel simulator (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 10: "We employ the popular narrowband millimeter wave (mmWave) clustered channel [44]." Custom clustered-channel simulator; no 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "demonstrate the generalization ability of DeepSC-MIMO in processing images with different resolutions" refers to STL10 (p. 10: "we also consider the dataset of higher resolution"), but the paper never states that a model trained on CIFAR10 was tested on STL10, and the other tests are SNR and codeword-length sweeps.
q3_support: p. 10: "emerging deep joint source-channel coding (DJSCC) scheme proposed in [4]" and "we also consider an SNR-adaptive scheme, the attention module-based DJSCC model (ADJSCC)" are earlier learned methods; no non-learned method (codebook or CS feedback, separate source-channel coding) is compared in any result.
q4_support: p. 13: "Table II compares the numbers of model parameters of different schemes." Table II lists DeepSC-MIMO at 0.492M parameters and the evaluator at 0.323M, 0.149M and 0.068M.
q5_support: p. 10: "We use the CIFAR10 dataset which consists of 50,000 color images" is a public image dataset of the learning task only; the channel is simulated and the paper gives no link to code or data.
notes: Included under area 2: SCAN performs CSI compression and feedback with a deep CSI codec (CLNet with 2D-DFT, p. 6-7) at several codeword lengths chosen per image by the learned PSNR evaluator (p. 7-9); DeepSC-MIMO uses an SVD precoder (p. 4) that is not learned. CLNet [28] is an existing network used as is (p. 10). Semantic JSCC alone would fail the function check, so if the reviewer judges that the learned part does not perform the feedback function, the alternative is exclusion with code function. q2 is 0 because the STL10 result is called generalization (p. 11) without saying which dataset trained the model; the reviewer may want to check. Table I (NMSE with and without 2D-DFT, p. 6), Table II (p. 13) and Figs. 7-13 were checked on the page images.
